creator: Claude Opus 5
base_note: Built from the v33 candidate tree. Everything Codex landed — the variable expander, the token scanner, current_url from browsing_page_url, the designer's variables panel — is carried forward and extended, not replaced.

what_v34_adds.unresolved_is_empty: A recognized variable with no value now leaves nothing behind. v33 substituted the literal 'not available', which the model reads aloud as if it were the answer. Three stand-in strings are gone: 'not available', 'not provided', 'not signed in'.
what_v34_adds.kept_deliberately: 'Visitor', 'User', '0' for message_count, and 'guest'/'visitor' for access level stay. Those are answers, not unknowns — a logged-out person really is a Visitor.
what_v34_adds.quiz_can_name_its_quiz: {score:ipa_basics} reads that quiz. Unnamed, {score} means the most recent quiz this person took. Any of the six quiz tokens takes a qualifier, and the same base token can name two different quizzes in one document.
what_v34_adds.quiz_identity: {quiz_id} and {quiz_title} name which quiz the unqualified values came from.
what_v34_adds.cost: A qualified token reads through FLOSC_Bridge_Data_Manager::get_flosc_bridge_data(), which already does per-quiz and most-recent. One lookup per distinct quiz per request, cached, and only reached when such a token is actually in the document.
what_v34_adds.malformed: {score:} matches nothing and is left exactly as written, the same rule already applied to any unrecognized brace.

verification.zip_gates: passed (277 entries, forbidden-path scan clean, single flosc/ root)

verification.personality_revision: NOT IN THIS BUILD — the four shipped profiles are unchanged from v31

still_open.heading_set: The fourteen slots are agreed and not yet coded: five relabels and two density swaps in SOUL_LAYERS, builder.js. Mission at 12, Traits at 30, Decisions at 56, Exceptions at 62, Workflow at 68, Banned Words to 74, Prosody and Syntax at 84.
still_open.title_alias: {title}, {public_title}, {product_name} and {app_name} all resolve to the same string on most flows.
still_open.library_entry_gap: builder.js libraryEntry() computes traits, mission, boundaries and topic_scope; saveToLibrary() sends four keys and not those. That is why those fields have no editor.
